thread:
elaine-sales: Morning — kicking off the Mosaic POC (customer: Mosaic Health). Need to align scope, success criteria, timeline, and who owns what. Quick agenda below and a couple of discovery Qs.

ryan-se: Thanks! Can we confirm the core use case? Mosaic mentioned "clinical note summarization + triage suggestions" in the last call.

miguel-solutions: Yup that's the ask. They want: 1) structured summary of encounter, 2) extract ICD codes, 3) a short triage note for RN review.

aj: (typo) ashley-cs: Copy — adding that they want PHI never leave their VPC in production. For POC they can share de-identified samples but security questionnaire pending.

jordan-customer: Correct — we'll provide 250 de-identified notes, and a small live stream of anonymized demo traffic if needed. Security Q: can you support our KMS + audit logs?

miguel-solutions: We can support customer-managed KMS in Private and Dedicated. For hosted we can provide encrypted-at-rest with our KMS — we should flag exact requirement to infra.

elaine-sales: POC checklist (proposed):
- Kickoff call with stakeholders (today)
- Dataset drop (250 de-id notes) by Wed
- Baseline eval run (automated prompts + gold labels) within 3 business days of dataset
- Live demo with 50 streamed notes and latency check
- Final success review and recommendation doc

ryan-se: Success criteria proposal:
- Summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.45 on the gold set
- Extraction F1 >= 0.82 for ICD mapping
- p95 latency for generate API < 300ms for 1024 tokens (demo traffic)
- Token cost per note < $0.20 for the quantized model config
- No PHI exfiltration; security questionnaire items marked "must have" resolved

ashley-cs: Can we add UX acceptance: nurses rate triage suggestions >= 4/5 in a small blind eval (n=10)?

miguel-solutions: Good call. Also: model fallback plan — if hosted throughput or latency bad, route to dedicated pool. We'll document the routing policy.

elaine-sales: Timeline ask from Mosaic: 2-week POC. Is that realistic?

ryan-se: Tight but doable if dataset arrives on Wed and we parallelize evals. Week 1: ingest + baseline + quick tuning. Week 2: live demo + iteration + wrap doc.

ashley-cs: Dependencies: security questionnaire completion, dataset, access for our QA to their staging environment, and decision on hosted vs dedicated for the POC.

elaine-sales: Pricing question from Mosaic — do we bill POC or is it included?

miguel-solutions: For 2-week POC we usually do a discounted POC credit (covers infra + eng support). I'll draft SOW and price estimate.

elaine-sales: Discovery questions for the kickoff (please call out owners):
- What success metrics does Mosaic care about most? (elaine)
- Who will provide clinician labels / gold set? (jordan)
- Any regulatory redlines (e.g., data residency) beyond KMS? (ashley)
- Preferred model family / token budget per note? (ryan)
- Integration point for triage output (FHIR, webhook, SFTP)? (miguel)

jordan-customer: We can provide clinician labels for a subset. Integration via HL7/FHIR preferred. Data residency: must stay in us-east for production.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: "mosaic-poc-dedicated" -> staging cluster at 2026-03-25T14:00:00Z

ryan-se: Prompt/eval examples to run on the baseline (I'll own):
```
Prompt A: "Summarize the encounter in 2-3 sentences and extract ICD-10 codes. Output JSON with keys: summary, icd10_codes, urgency_level."
Prompt B: "Given the note, produce a single-sentence triage suggestion for an RN."
```
I'll include an eval harness with ROUGE and tokenized F1 for code extraction.

miguel-solutions: I'll prepare the routing and quantization suggestion: try q4_0 first, measure latency/cost; fallback to int8 if instability.

ashley-cs: I'll chase the security questionnaire items: send the TODO list to jordan after this thread.

elaine-sales: OK — actions: Miguel draft SOW + price by EOD, Ryan build baseline prompts and eval harness, Ashley send security TODO, Jordan drop dataset by Wed, Elaine schedule next stakeholder sync Fri.

jordan-customer: Sounds good. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

miguel-solutions: I'll also add a short runbook for the POC: who to ping during incidents, and an emergency fallback to 3rd-party model if our pool is unhealthy.

elaine-sales: Great — I'll run the kickoff in 30.
